modes.name: trunk_forward
modes.plus: Trunk shifts forward relative to planted feet.
modes.minus: Trunk shifts backward relative to planted feet.

modes.name: trunk_left
modes.plus: Trunk shifts left relative to planted feet.
modes.minus: Trunk shifts right relative to planted feet.

modes.name: trunk_lower
modes.plus: Trunk lowers as all knees bend and hips compensate for rearward foot motion.
modes.minus: Trunk lowers less deeply; the nearly extended home posture leaves little upward travel.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along z

modes.name: trunk_roll_left
modes.plus: Trunk rolls left, lowering its left side.
modes.minus: Trunk rolls right, lowering its right side.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along y

modes.name: trunk_pitch_forward
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along pitch

modes.name: trunk_yaw_left
modes.plus: Trunk turns left relative to planted feet.
modes.minus: Trunk turns right relative to planted feet.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along x

modes.name: fl_tip_forward
modes.plus: Left front foot moves forward and up.
modes.minus: Left front foot moves backward and up.

modes.name: fl_tip_left
modes.plus: Left front foot moves left while lifted.
modes.minus: Left front foot moves right while lifted.

modes.name: fr_tip_forward
modes.plus: Right front foot moves forward and up.
modes.minus: Right front foot moves backward and up.

modes.name: fr_tip_left
modes.plus: Right front foot moves left while lifted.
modes.minus: Right front foot moves right while lifted.

modes.name: hl_tip_forward
modes.plus: Left hind foot moves forward and up.
modes.minus: Left hind foot moves backward and up.

modes.name: hl_tip_left
modes.plus: Left hind foot moves left while lifted.
modes.minus: Left hind foot moves right while lifted.

modes.name: hr_tip_forward
modes.plus: Right hind foot moves forward and up.
modes.minus: Right hind foot moves backward and up.

modes.name: hr_tip_left
modes.plus: Right hind foot moves left while lifted.
modes.minus: Right hind foot moves right while lifted.

modes.name: fl_tip_up
modes.plus: Left front leg folds deeply, bringing its foot upward.
modes.minus: Left front leg folds shallowly, bringing its foot upward less.

modes.name: fr_tip_up
modes.plus: Right front leg folds deeply, bringing its foot upward.
modes.minus: Right front leg folds shallowly, bringing its foot upward less.

modes.name: hl_tip_up
modes.plus: Left hind leg folds deeply, bringing its foot upward.
modes.minus: Left hind leg folds shallowly, bringing its foot upward less.

modes.name: hr_tip_up
modes.plus: Right hind leg folds deeply, bringing its foot upward.
modes.minus: Right hind leg folds shallowly, bringing its foot upward less.
